entry.title: Cayan Tower
entry.note: Exact mapped tower center and signed rectangle are retained. The primary site north arrow points upper-right: page-right/northeast is the attached podium. GroundY0 is the public entrance apron; the rectangle is a registration envelope and the detailed chevron and podium are primary-plan reconstruction. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
